_provenance.generated_by: Transfer matrix Lyapunov exponent computation for 1D Almost-Mathieu operator
_provenance.data_origin: Analytical: Almost-Mathieu Hamiltonian with golden-ratio frequency. All results derivable from Aubry-André duality and Herman's formula.

_description: Aubry-André metal-insulator transition in the Almost-Mathieu operator: extended states for λ<2, localized for λ>2, with Herman's formula γ=ln(λ/2)
_groundspring_question: When structured (quasiperiodic) noise replaces random disorder, does the same localization phenomenology hold — and can we predict the exact transition point?

model._description: 1D Almost-Mathieu: H ψ(n) = ψ(n+1) + ψ(n-1) + 2λ cos(2παn + θ) ψ(n). α = golden ratio ≈ 0.618, θ = 0.

analytical_predictions._description: Aubry-André duality: transition at λ=2. Herman's formula: γ = max(0, ln(λ/2)) for E=0. Level statistics: quasi-integrable (strong repulsion, <r> ~ 0.9) for extended (λ<2), Poisson for localized (λ>2).
